column1: # Quest compatibility corpus. Tab-separated. Quest DATA is never committed --
# scripts/fetch_corpus.sh clones each entry at its pinned ref.
# ref MUST target a quest whose declared solarus_version is engine-compatible
# (major 1, minor 5 or 6 -- "1.5 quests can be run by Solarus 1.6"). Many
# quests' master/dev branches target Solarus 2.x and will not load on our
# 1.6.5 engine (see scripts/fetch_quest.sh). Two quests below have no tags at
# all, so they are pinned by commit SHA (their master head at time of survey).
